summary: Catalogued the real, on-screen, non-speaking animals for the realistic Alice adaptation. Per SUP-002 (cultivation.json, approved H1 5.1 A) and WRITE_RULES.md precedent P-007, every talking animal/card figure is a human-performed dream-figure and registers as CHAR-*, not here. Registered 4 CRE-* entries for the animals the source text itself keeps mute and un-costumed: the silent white rabbit in the waking frame, and three real (never-speaking) animals inside the dream — the puppy (ch004), and the flamingo and hedgehog used as live croquet equipment (ch008).

entries_registered.name: The White Rabbit (waking-world, real animal)
entries_registered.note: Real, silent rabbit in the ch001 waking-world bracket only; deliberately distinct from CHAR-white-rabbit, the talking dream-figure herald.

entries_registered.name: The Puppy
entries_registered.note: ch004 dream sequence; never speaks; 'enormous' reads purely from Alice's own SUP-003 scale, not the puppy's real size.

entries_registered.name: The Flamingo
entries_registered.note: ch008 croquet-ground; live mallet; per SUP-011 never shown being struck.

entries_registered.name: The Hedgehog
entries_registered.note: ch008 croquet-ground; live ball; per SUP-011 never shown being struck.

excluded_candidates.reason: Never physically appears on screen anywhere in the source (ch001/ch002/ch003/ch004 mentions are all Alice speaking/thinking of her). Per H1 ruling 5.3 B she is echoed only as light doubling into the Cheshire Cat performer (CHAR-*, owned by 03-characters). No CRE entry created.

excluded_candidates.candidate: waking-frame farm animals (sheep, cattle) from the sister's closing reverie, ch012-p70
excluded_candidates.reason: The paragraph is explicit that the sister sits 'with closed eyes' and only imagines what the sounds would become 'though she knew she had but to open them again' — a counterfactual hearing, not a witnessed sight. SUP-001's own sound_signature already renders this as ambient audio bleed, not a visual cutaway. No drawable on-screen appearance is committed to by the locked Bible, so no CRE entry was created; flagged in creature.json _meta for 07-directing to return here if a visible farmyard cutaway is later staged.
All verbal similes or drowsy word-play (ch012-p01/02, ch004-p38, ch001-p10, ch003-p43), never accompanied by an on-screen scene.

excluded_candidates.candidate: Magpie, Canary, and the rest of the ch002-ch003 pool/Caucus-race cast beyond the already CHAR-forward-referenced Mouse/Dodo/Duck/Lory/Eaglet
excluded_candidates.reason: Magpie and Canary have direct quoted dialogue (ch003-d0068/d0069); per SUP-002 all speaking animals are CHAR-* human performers, owned by 03-characters/character-manager, not this agent.

excluded_candidates.candidate: the guinea-pig juror (H1 ruling 5.4 B: sack over head/shoulders, hustled out)
excluded_candidates.reason: Part of the court's speaking jury (SUP-002 source_element explicitly lists 'jurors'); a CHAR-*, not a creature.

cross_domain_notes: bible/_index.json forward_refs_pending.ids lists CHAR-white-rabbit as a pending character registration (the dream-figure herald). CRE-001 in this file is a separate entity (the real, mute, waking-world rabbit) and does not duplicate or conflict with that pending CHAR id; creature.json CRE-001.distinct_from documents the split explicitly so downstream prompt/image-gen agents do not merge the two (e.g. give the real rabbit a waistcoat and watch).
No conflicts found with the locked Bible (cultivation.json SUP-001/002/003/011, world.json wonderland_real_counterparts, WRITE_RULES.md P-007). No qa/defects/ filed.
